Hero.title: Your Journey to Studying Abroad Starts Here
Hero.description: Salam Consulting provides professional education consulting services for students pursuing international study opportunities. We support students throughout the journey—from university selection and applications to documentation, visas, and preparation for studying abroad.

About.title: Who We Are
About.subtitle: Building global bridges through world-class education
About.storyDesc: Salam Consulting was founded in February 2024 in Dushanbe, Tajikistan, by young entrepreneur and education advocate Abdurahmonbek Akhmedov. The company was established with a vision to help students access international education opportunities and receive professional guidance throughout their journey to studying abroad.
About.missionDesc: To empower ambitious students by connecting them with life-changing global educational opportunities, and to serve as a trusted bridge between international talent and prestigious universities worldwide.
About.visionDesc: To be the leading global education consultancy recognized for absolute integrity, exceptional success rates, and transformative impact on students' lives.
About.whyUsDesc: For Universities and Investors, Salam Consulting represents a dedicated gateway to high-potential talent in Central Asia and beyond. We operate on Silicon Valley principles of transparency, data-driven matching, and uncompromising quality.

Contact.title: Get in Touch
Contact.subtitle: Whether you're a student ready to start your journey or an institution looking to partner, we're here to help.

Footer.empowering: Empowering your academic journey worldwide with professional consulting and personalized guidance.
